page.overview:
Who is Catalyst Comets?

A Catalyst Comet is a massive comet that hits the Earth every 1000 years. It is revealed in "Evergreen" and "Astral Plane" that the comet has hit the planet repeatedly, always bringing with it some kind of agent of change.

During the Cretaceous period, a green incarnation of the comet approached Earth, its impact to cause the end of most life on the planet. The Ice Elemental, Urgence Evergreen, sought to prevent this catastrophe using a magical crown that he had created to grant its wearer's deepest wish. This plan was opposed by his fellow Elementals, who feared its power could cause irreparable damage to the structure of existence. Evergreen responded by freezing them and proceeded with his plan. However, Evergreen would be incapacitated, forcing his apprentice Gunther to don the crown. Deep down, Gunther wished to be just like his master. In response, he began transforming into what he truly saw Evergreen as: a cruel ice wizard. As he succumb to insanity, the comet struck, causing the mass extinction of life on Earth, including the dinosaurs. This comet was in fact the Lich as the incarnation of pure evil, shown by its horn-shaped flames, a "desire for extinction," and green coloration, just like the Lich himself.

Thousands of years before the main Adventure Time era, a yellow incarnation of the catalyst comet appeared and a Primordial Monster known as Orgalorg, the Breaker of Worlds, attempted to absorb it to gain its power. Abraham Lincoln, King of Mars disapproved, and ordered Grob Gob Glob Grod to intervene. Grob Gob Glob Grod incapacitated Orgalorg before he could intercept the comet and the latter fell to Earth, his body pressed by the Earth's gravity into a penguin.

One of Finn's past lives was a blue incarnation of the comet, which struck Earth sometime after the Mushroom War. Being the incarnation of pure good, this comet led to the creation of the hero who would thwart the Lich's plans and battle various other threats.
